text: {"rulings": [{"id": "1", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Customs docs being PDFs and being stored in object storage are both true at once; format and storage location are different facts."}, {"id": "2", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "A shipment having customs docs and those docs living in object storage are both true; one describes the data model, the other where the files are kept."}, {"id": "3", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The Meridian database can still be Postgres while customs docs are kept outside it in object storage; the new claim only says the files are not in the database, not that there is no database."}, {"id": "4", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Deploying to Vercel says nothing about where customs docs are stored; both hold."}, {"id": "5", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "A TypeScript stack and object storage for customs docs are independent facts that coexist."}]}
